PROBE CONCLUSION 2026-07-28: IBKR error 10349 was OUR BUG, not a Gateway Order Preset needing a GUI fix. place_bracket_order built the parent LimitOrder with no explicit tif; the preset filled in the blank with DAY and announced it. The error's reqId was always the PARENT's, and the stop leg — which always carried explicit tif=GTC — kept GTC at IBKR throughout (verified via reqAllOpenOrders). Setting the parent to tif=DAY explicitly eliminates 10349 entirely: re-probe returned LMT tif=DAY / STP tif=GTC, both PreSubmitted, no error. All three probe orders cancelled, 0 leftovers, account unchanged at 4 positions.
